Small (5 lines each) and low churn-risk -- not blocking. override.repo_standard: CREW_CONTEXT.md 'Verification Discipline': a check's evidence must explain WHY it is trustworthy (mutation-proof, not text-matched), and this repo's own convention (seen throughout d102c05, gs-implement-RESULT.md, landing-zone-measurement.md) is dense class/comment docstrings that carry the reasoning a reviewer needs to re-verify the check, not prose covering for weak code.
override.reason: MapTreeFreshnessTests' class docstring and the .gitignore block comment are long, but each sentence carries a fact a reviewer needs and cannot get from the code alone (why 2 files not 116, why text-mode not raw bytes, why map/* + two negations not a narrower rule) -- I independently verified every one of those facts this pass (the CRLF/text-mode claim, the 2-file measurement, the check-ignore behavior) and each held. This is documentation of non-obvious invariants, not a code smell masking bad structure -- the underlying code (a 6-line test, a 3-line gitignore stanza) is simple on its own merits.
